definition.en: The number each item would have if the total were shared equally among all the items.
definition.zh: 把总数平均分给每一项时，每一项得到的数。

definition.en: All the values added together. The syllabus calls it the "total value".
definition.zh: 所有数据加起来。课纲写作 “total value”。

definition.en: How many values there are. The syllabus says "number of data". A value of 0 is still an item.
definition.zh: 一共有几项数据；课纲写作 “number of data”。0 也算一项。

definition.en: Moving from the bigger amounts to the smaller ones until all are the same.
definition.zh: 把多的移给少的，直到一样多。

definition.en: Numbers that were counted or measured.
definition.zh: 数出来、量出来的一组数。

definition.en: Share so that every part gets the same amount.
A dashed line drawn across a chart at the height of the average.
definition.zh: 图上画在平均数高度的一条虚线。

definition.en: One of the values in a set of data.
